English

[edit]
English Wikipedia has an article on:
arrogance
Wikipedia
Wikiquote has a collection of quotations related to:
Arrogance
Wikiquote

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • arrogaunce (obsolete)

Etymology

[edit]

From Middle English arrogaunce, from Middle French arrogance, from Latin arrogantia.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (without the Mary–marry–merry merger) IPA(key): /ˈæɹ.ə.ɡəns/
  • Audio (Southern England):(file)
  • (Mary–marry–merry merger, US, Canada) IPA(key): /ˈɛɹ.ə.ɡəns/
  • Audio (US):(file)

Noun

[edit]

arrogance (usually uncountable, plural arrogances)

  1. The state of being arrogant; a type of extreme or foolish pride in which someone feels much superior to another.
    Synonyms: see Thesaurus:arrogance
    Antonym: servility

Related terms

[edit]
  • arrogancy
  • arrogant
  • arrogate
  • arrogation

Translations

[edit]
act or habit of arrogating, or making undue claims in an overbearing manner
